sections.title: Comprehensive Care C
sections.description: Fourth-year students, within their PCU groups, continue to perform examination and diagnostic procedures, comprehensive treatment planning, all restorative dental procedures, fixed and removable prosthodontic procedures, including implant supported restorations, non-surgical periodontal procedures, and maintenance therapy. The PCU program goal is to produce a practitioner who can integrate basic scienc knowledge with clinical profiency in all phases of general dentistry, based on the concept of recognition and treatment of oral disease.
